sample_unit: medication tasks (formulation matching, DDI pairs, medication orders)

links.outcome: GPT-4o medication order generation errors (medication or abbreviation errors)
links.effect: GPT-4o generated order sentences containing no medication or abbreviation errors in 65.8% of the cases, so about one third contained errors.
links.quote: For the third task, GPT-4o generated order sentences containing no medication or abbreviation errors in 65.8% of the cases.

links.outcome: GPT-4o accuracy in identifying drug-drug interaction pairs and formulations
links.effect: DDI pair identification accuracy was 54.7%; formulation matching accuracy was 49% with 1.23 omissions and 1.14 hallucinations per medication.
links.quote: For the second task of drug-drug interaction identification, the accuracy was 54.7% for identifying the DDI pair.

screen.reason: Evaluates GPT-4o's baseline accuracy on three simulated medication management tasks using clinician and automated metrics; it does not test a specific organizational safeguard or deployment practice.
